name: Penicillin-Cephalosporin Cross-Reactivity
description: Cross-reactivity data between penicillin and cephalosporin antibiotic classes.

entries.notes: Cephalosporin caution in patients with immediate penicillin anaphylaxis
Use with caution in penicillin-allergic patients
Consider alternative if severe IgE-mediated penicillin allergy
Lower cross-reactivity; can use with monitoring

entries.source_note: Data derived from clinical guidelines and meta-analyses of cross-reactivity rates
